This torrent contains the game [Subarashiki Hibi ~Furenzoku Sonzai~ Full Voice HD Edition](https://vndb.org/r56597) fully patched into English.

This was achieved by combining the preexisting [patch](https://vndb.org/r66338) that ports the official English translation to the FVHD edition with my own newly created translation patch for the bonus chapter, Knockin' on Heaven's Door.

This torrent includes save data that has fully completed the main game (i.e. full chapter select and CG gallery) that is intended for those who have already played the official English release and simply want to experience the new content. If you would rather start with a completely fresh game, do not download (or simply delete) the files "BGI.gdb" and "BGI.hvl" from the game's root folder.

Please read "KoHD_readme.txt" for important information regarding the bonus chapter's English translation.

***The patch for Knockin' on Heaven's Door has now been updated to v1.1, fixing many punctuation and formatting mistakes, as well as a handful of typos and translation issues. This upload is virtually identical to my previous one, the only files that have been changed are "extra" and "KoHD_readme.txt". Any help seeding this torrent would be greatly appreciated.***
